summary: Frontend E2E testing of DriverVehicleAccessCard (Accès aux véhicules) on Jean Dupont driver sheet completed. All 8 scenarios PASS: (1) Section visible with 3 radio modes + default ALL checked + hint text OK. (2) SELECTED mode with search 'AUDI' filters correctly, LOGITRAK AUDI + ORHAN + IVAN + NEDIR selected → counter '4 véhicules sélectionnés'. (3) Default select shows only 4 selected + Aucun (5 options), selection saved with toast 'Les accès véhicules de ce chauffeur ont été mis à jour.'. (4) Persistence verified after reload: mode-selected checked, 4 checkboxes, default=LOGITRAK AUDI. (5) SINGLE mode reduces selection to 1, clicking a different vehicle replaces (never 2), single-hint shown, save toast OK. (6) Restoration to production state (ALL + default Aucun) saved and verified after reload. (7) RBAC manager: readonly notice 'Modification réservée aux administrateurs.' visible, save button hidden (count=0), radios have data-disabled attribute. (8) Security list contains exactly 18 vehicles all from LOGITRAK account (LOGITRAK/KAIO/GE-*/Enyaq/ORHAN/IVAN/NEDIR/Alliance/Iphone/Tab plates) — no cross-tenant leak.
